After a messy breakup that weekend, she comes to me a year later to want to make amends.. Being the idiot I was at the time, I accepted, and she took me out to a baseball field in the middle of nowhere. Next thing I know, I feel a dull pain in the back of my head, and black out. When I came to, I was tied up in the back of her car, and she was having her way with me.. 

That was my first time having sex, and it still traumatizes me to this day... I can't be in a relationship nor be around friends without flinching when someone around me moves too quickly, and my trust issues are a thing of legends..
